skill_name: How would you describe the current trend of organic food consumption?
workflow: Organic food consumption is becoming increasingly popular in today's society. Consumers are looking for foods that are more natural and free from preservatives, artificial flavors, and other harmful chemicals found in processed foods. With an increase in overall awareness and education regarding the benefits of organic food consumption, many are turning to organic food products and seeking out organic, local farmers as an alternative to traditional farming and mass-produced foods.
